reason_code_labels.randomized_withdrawal: Randomized withdrawal outside the eligible initial contrast

route_explanations.paired_screening_exclusion: Both supplied returns record a screening exclusion; this is not a full-text exclusion or independent accuracy estimate.
route_explanations.citation_tracking_source: Retained for tracing reports and trials; this source is not counted as an additional randomized unit.
route_explanations.forward_to_documentary_eligibility: Forwarded for source-based eligibility and family assessment; not final admission.
route_explanations.pending_information: The recorded material was insufficient; no exclusion is inferred.
route_explanations.pending_disagreement: The supplied decisions differ; the disagreement remains visible.
route_explanations.planning_registry_pending_trial_eligibil: Planning status retained separately; no completed eligible trial is inferred.
route_explanations.reopen_native_version_review: A changed representation prompted a bounded version-impact check, not a new trial.
route_explanations.prior_decision_preserved: The prior decision was retained with the newer representation archived.

rationale_language: Original author-written decision explanations remain in Portuguese, marked as recorded. English code/route descriptions are interpretative labels, not substitute study-specific rationales.
